title: Intestinal BMP SMADs impart the mid-villus pattern through a transcription factor cascade mechanism.
snippet: Differentiated cells of the intestinal villus are not a monolith of equivalent cell types, but an exquisitely patterned continuum of transdifferentiated cells with evolving functions.
